messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: When cholesterol and fats build up along your artery walls.
This process is called atherosclerosis.
Cholesterol and fats narrow the blood vessels.
This reduces blood and oxygen flow to your heart, brain, and other parts of your body.
Atorvastatin helps prevent this buildup.
This is done by slowing cholesterol production.
This keeps blood flowing more freely to vital organs.
Lowering your blood level of cholesterol and fats with atorvastatin may help prevent heart disease.
It may also help prevent angina (chest pain).
It may also help prevent strokes.
It may also help prevent heart attacks.
Your healthcare provider will check your blood lipid levels regularly to assess how well your treatment is working.
These measurements include:
LDL-C: Low-density lipoprotein (“bad” cholesterol)
HDL-C: High-density lipoprotein (“good” cholesterol)
TG: Triglycerides (a type of blood fat)
Total-C: Total cholesterol
Triplet: ["Atorvastatin", "helps prevent", "angina"]

The relation 'helps prevent' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is used to reduce the likelihood of the object entity occurring.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'caused by': The subject condition is caused by the pathogen or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'may stop treatment if': The subject entity (usually a healthcare provider) may discontinue treatment based on the condition or situation described by the object entity.
D. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
